description: This file defines the PHP class `StockStatus` within the `Opencart.Admin.Controller.Localisation` namespace. It manages CRUD operations for stock statuses in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, saving, and deleting stock statuses. It handles localization, paging, sorting, and permissions, and constructs views with necessary data and breadcrumbs.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Controller class for managing stock statuses in the OpenCart admin panel, providing methods for listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting stock status entries, with localization, pagination, and permission checks.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the list of stock statuses with pagination, sorting, and breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of stock statuses, outputting the result of getList().

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of stock statuses, including sorting, ordering, pagination, and forming the view output.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a stock status, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the POST request to add or update a stock status, with validation and permission checks, returning JSON responses.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected stock statuses after permission validation, responds with JSON.
